items.title: Base change of the tame symbol along a flat local homomorphism of 1-dimensional Noetherian local rings
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file chow.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The statement compares two elements living in different residue fields: partial_A(a_1,a_2) raised to m = length_{A'}(A'/mA') in kappa must map to partial_{A'}(a_1,a_2) in kappa' for a flat local homomorphism A to A' of 1-dimensional Noetherian local rings. The proof at chow.tex lines 1031-1050 must first transport the factorization data along the flat base change B' = A' tensor_A B and index the maximal ideals of B' over those of B, which is what makes the two displayed products comparable at all. The remaining work is the single displayed identity of lines 1055-1061, proved by identifying the norm power with det_kappa(u : B_j/pi_j B_j to itself), applying flat base change of determinants and then splitting the base-changed module over the maximal ideals of B' (lines 1062-1085); the exponent m = length_{A'}(A'/mA') is exactly what makes the two determinant expressions match.
